page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors based on the x86_64 architecture, providing 104 dedicated virtual CPUs running at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 192.0 GB of system memory, resulting in an allocation of 1.85 GB of RAM per vCPU. This low memory-to-vCPU ratio establishes a high-density compute profile engineered to maximize parallel thread execution without dedicating excess capacity to memory overhead.

The server includes no integrated local storage, requiring all persistent storage and root filesystem mounts to use network-attached block volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation, facilitating high-throughput node-to-node communication in distributed environments. There are no GPU accelerators included with this configuration, focusing all system resources entirely on CPU execution and networking.

With its 104 dedicated execution threads, the instance delivers high compute capacity per host instance. Tradeoffs include the dependency on remote network storage for disk operations and the relatively constrained per-core memory footprint. The configuration is primarily suited for CPU-bound parallel workloads, distributed worker clusters, batch processing, media transcoding, scientific modeling, and high-concurrency web serving infrastructure.
